svg.title: Disorders of sexual differentiation pathway: the newborn with ambiguous genitalia is karyotyped first; 46,XY under-virilisation splits into 5-alpha-reductase deficiency, androgen insensitivity and testis or androgen-synthesis failure, and 46,XX virilisation into salt-wasting and simple virilising 21-hydroxylase deficiency and other sources of fetal androgen, with assessment, management at birth, sex chromosome DSD and non-classic CAH along the bottom
